description: This script manages build processes for a project involving OpenClaw. It imports Node.js core modules and a local module, performs filesystem cleanup of symlinks, runs a build command via spawnSync, and processes output to detect specific build issues like unresolved imports and ineffective dynamic imports.

methods.name: removeDistPluginNodeModulesSymlinks
methods.description: Removes symbolic links to node_modules within 'extensions' directories under a specified root directory.

methods.name: pruneStaleRuntimeSymlinks
methods.description: Removes stale runtime symlinks from 'dist' and 'dist-runtime' directories in the current working directory.

methods.name: findFatalUnresolvedImport
methods.description: Parses output lines to detect unresolved import errors outside extensions and returns the problematic line if found.
